headline: China Securities Bourses Announce Policy Measures to Support Equities
summary: The Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock exchanges issued a joint policy package under CSRC guidance. The measures aim to enhance liquidity and stabilize mainland A-share market performance.
why: The China Securities Regulatory Commission oversees mainland financial exchanges and equity market stability.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite
impacts.why: Regulatory measures introduced across mainland exchanges aim to provide structural support for equity trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: China regulatory bodies announced coordinated market support rules to bolster mainland stock indices.
